posts.text: Shares of Nvidia tumbled 5% at the opening bell Monday after the computer chip maker, central to the artificial intelligence race, opened an investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.” Nvidia’s announcement of the investigation on Sunday followed Huang’s…

Briefing.com analyst Patrick O’Hare said that Nvidia was being treated as a one-off story by investors for the moment. “In other words, the stock is being penalised for Jensen Huang’s personal transgression, which has invited a great deal of uncertainty into the mix, but the market isn’t caught up in the notion that…
Despite the drag from Nvidia, the Nasdaq Composite share index (which contains companies from across the tech sector) is up 2% in early trading.

Despite the chip giant’s troubles, the DJIA has jumped by 661 points, or 1.3%, to 51,947 points in early trading. posts.title: Closing Summary
posts.text: We’re still getting reaction coming through in response to the sentencing but I’m going to leave it for there. I’ll recap what we saw in court today. Firstly, the top line: Russell Brand, one of Britain’s most high-profile former actor-comedians, the star of several Hollywood films in the 2000s and 2010s, has been…

Russell Brand has been jailed today to more than 10 years for raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others. All of them gave victim impact statements to the court, all of which were read out today for the judge to hear as he considered the punishment he would give to Brand. One woman also chose to come into…

Justice Joel Bennathan delivered an eight-page judgement at the sentencing today. The punishment – the full length of the prison term Russell Brand will serve for the next 10 years– was delivered right at the end in the 80-second clip below. You can watch it here.

posts.title: Brand spoke to wife as he was taken away
posts.text: The court drawing below depicts how Brand spoke to his wife Laura Brand as he was led away to the cells. After the 10.5 year sentence was passed, Ms Brand told her husband “I love you”. He said to her as he was being taken out: “We’ll be okay.” Ms Brand left the courtroom in tears. The couple have three children…

Senior crown prosecutor David Roberts spoke after Det Supt Furphy, and said that: Today’s result shows that fame, status, and a passage of time do not change the fundamental issue of consent. He says the evidence presented to court showed Brand to be a “manipulative sexual predator, using his growing fame and power to…

We know it can take enormous courage to speak about what happened to you. No matter how long ago it occurred, or who was responsible, if…

posts.title: Judge added two years to rape sentence for Brand removing condom and other serious aggravating factors
posts.text: Regarding the rape sentencing, Judge Bennathan noted that Brand ordering the then 21-year-old woman to “clean your sheets” was “an additional… humiliation”. He also said that Brand removing the condom without her consent, and ejaculating into her “which led to months of fearing she might have HIV” were “serious…

These are the details of the rape conviction, where Brand in 2009 anally raped a 21-year-old fan of his, removed the condom and ejaculated in her, humiliated her afterwards and left her terrified that she might have contracted HIV. The judge summarised the crime as following: She was a huge fan of yours, which you…

Russell Brand was sentenced to nine years for the rape conviction alone. He was acquitted of two other rape counts, but because of this count, has received such a serious sentence behind bars. Judge Bennathan went into length on this offence, and I will get into that in the next post.

The judge had said he was “very conscious” that Brand’s imprisonment would “deprive your children of the presence of their father”. That sad loss to them, however, is caused by your serious offending. Brand’s lawyer Ian Winter KC earlier had strenuously made the case that a lengthy sentence would have a “catastrophic”…

Judge Bennathan also commended the Met Police for “their hard work in gathering evidence and taking great care of all the women who testified.” As I reported earlier, one of the victims said she had wanted to withdraw her case after the stress and pressure and public attention, but she persisted with the support of…

I do not increase your punishment becauseof it but all those women had to face being confronted and…
Officers have taken Brand out of the courtroom. He has served a few days at HMP Wandsworth already, after being denied bail last Thursday following his conviction.

posts.title: 'Insufficient' emissions cuts in the EU - report

The report, published today by the European Environment Agency (EEA), found EU emissions fell by 1.6% in 2025, though at a slower pace than the year…

Last week, my colleague Adam Morton sat down with the Australian climate minister, Chris Bowen, who is leading the official negotiations. He put some of the apparent contradictions in Australia’s own climate record to the minister – a high-emitting nation chairing climate negotiations while exporting fossil fuels and…
